item.title: Palantir soars 12% on blowout quarter, with U.S. commercial revenue soaring nearly 150%

item.description: U.S. crude oil prices have gained about 20% since the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28.

item.title: California's diesel prices have jumped since the Iran war started, with ripple effects across the country
item.description: California has the highest gas prices in the country as well as the busiest containership port, meaning consumers across the country could feel the impact of higher diesel.

item.title: Kalshi traders are not expecting a U.S. and Iran nuclear deal soon

item.title: More tech millionaires are using donor-advised funds for tax savings and giving
